question: Which feature of repeated frozen vehicle GPS fixes makes Naver Map treat location as lost under Android Auto?
evidence_policy: observations and user-supplied premises are separate; no claims about vehicle wire payload or timestamps

environment.phone_environment: indoors; user observed Kakao Map placing phone near the building, actual GPS signal strength unverified
environment.connection: USB ADB tunnel to Android Auto head unit server, tcp:5277
environment.guidance_route: 2.6 km on trials 1-3 and final trial 4; early section north then east on Dongbaek-ro

source_premise_unverified.description: The linked prompt says a real car repeats a frozen position at roughly 1 Hz with stale nonzero speed/bearing and no accuracy. This was not independently measured in this run.

config_exact:
[general]
touch = true
resolution = 800x480
dpi = 160

[sensors]
location = true
driving_status = true
console_help_note: Pass in NAN to skip optional parameters if needed.

nan_accuracy_test.conclusion: NAN in the accuracy slot was accepted by DHU syntax. The actual Android Auto sensor payload or whether an accuracy field was absent was not captured.

common_drive_in.observation: All four trials began with active guidance; the blue marker followed the route and remaining distance shrank from about 2.6 km to 2.4 km during drive-in, then about 2.3 km as position settled.

H1_no_accuracy_alone_causes_rejection.verdict: not supported as a sufficient condition
H1_no_accuracy_alone_causes_rejection.reason: Trial 4 used NAN accuracy and held a blue marker for 60 s, unlike trial 1; the precise wire representation of NAN was not verified.

H2_identical_fix_alone_is_stale.verdict: not supported as a sufficient condition
H2_identical_fix_alone_is_stale.reason: Trials 2 and 4 repeated identical coordinates for 60 s yet retained blue markers.

H3_nonzero_stale_speed_extrapolates_only.verdict: not supported in this DHU run
H3_nonzero_stale_speed_extrapolates_only.reason: Trial 1 had active guidance and nonzero stale speed, but displayed GPS loss and held rather than advancing along the route.

interaction_observed: NAN accuracy + 14 m/s + unchanged coordinates led to GPS-LOST; accuracy 5 + 14 m/s and NAN accuracy + 0 m/s led to FOLLOWS-AND-HOLDS. This pattern does not identify a single underlying validation rule.
deviations_and_limits: After trial 1, reposition attempts with one and five accurate fixes did not move the gray marker. DHU restart and guidance restart were needed before trial 2.
After trial 2, a single accurate reposition fix again failed. DHU and guidance were restarted before trial 3.

Before trial 4, route selection temporarily showed a different 2.8 km local route and then a 401 km Seoul-origin route. Those attempts were discarded. DHU was restarted and the same 2.6 km route was confirmed before trial 4.
Screenshot sampling every 10 s bounds GPS loss onset to (0,10] s; it does not identify an exact second.
No Android Auto sensor protocol trace was captured; NAN command acceptance does not prove the exact transmitted field representation.
Real Mazda vehicle, its GPS timestamp handling, and any wireless dongle were not tested.
The actual satellite GPS strength of the phone was not measured.
